$meta.source: https://renkim.com/ (Breakdance/WordPress), extracted 2026-10-10 via Chrome computed styles + the site's global palette custom properties
$meta.method: getComputedStyle() over every rendered element (text color, background, border, font) + :root --bde-palette-* variables in global-settings.css
notes: The palette below is the site's own Breakdance global palette; every value was also observed in computed styles on the homepage.
No new brand colors are introduced. Neutrals are the site's own greys plus pure white/near-black.
Third-party social colors (Facebook #4267B2, LinkedIn #0077B5) appear only on the social icon chips and are not brand colors.

blue.usage: Primary buttons (Services, Contact), dual-heading accent on white, links, icon chips

deepBlue.usage: Gradient anchor, Schedule A Call tab, incident banner background

green.usage: Contact Us button, icon badges, dual-heading accent on blue, scroll-progress bar

grey.usage: Body copy (most frequent text color, 55 elements)

darkGrey.usage: Nav links, text on green buttons

glassFill.usage: Industry pills on the blue gradient

blueToBlue.usage: Industries band, 'Ready to Talk' form card

transparentBlue.usage: Overlay on the employee-owned warehouse photo

brand.notes: Loaded as a variable font (weight axis 200–800). Every rendered text node uses it except 2 system-ui fallbacks.

font.textTransform: Dual headings render with text-transform: capitalize on the live site (source copy is sentence/title mixed).

motionSignatures.annotate: Secondary words in some dual headings carry class js-annotate: a hand-drawn underline (Rough Notation style) drawn on reveal. Reused in the redesign as an SVG stroke draw.
motionSignatures.scrollProgress: A thin green (#00FF84) scroll-progress bar runs across the top of the viewport.
motionSignatures.waveLines: Light-blue fine-line wave PNGs (Renkim_Wave-Lines_*) decorate the hero and contact card.
